hints: Before and after describe numbered positions, not the order in which the cards are currently displayed.
Combine the notes into one sequence. The candle comes before the oak, and the mirror comes after the oak.
The complete order is Candle, Oak, Mirror, Pear, Apple, Star, Shell. Read their first letters.

provenance.source: Original Mapmaker’s Cabinet seven-card episode authored for LUDOLINGUA.

episode.story: The expedition leaves at dawn, but the mapmaker’s cabinet is locked. Its contents are needed to chart the next route. Across the desk lie seven labeled specimens and keepsakes, scattered during the packing. The oak label belongs to a small wood sample; the star label belongs to a brass token. Beside them is a note: “Restore my collection to its numbered places, first through seventh. Read the first letter of each label in that order, then enter the instrument’s English name.” Use the surviving arrangement notes to open the cabinet.
episode.title: The Mapmaker’s Cabinet
